Nice structure. A few concise edits I recommend for the public GDoc before we share more widely:

- Add clear acceptance criteria rows with owner and verification method (e.g., "99th pctl latency ≤ 200ms on 1k qps test run — infra owner verifies via perf run").
- Include a one-line "must have" vs "nice to have" column for each milestone so execs can scan tradeoffs.
- Add a data classification row (PII / PHI) given BrightPath is health — link to our SOC 2 evidence page.
- Convert the Slides intro to a single slide with timeline + milestones (visual).

Irene — I can take the GDoc and drop these rows + build the Slides timeline if you want. I suggest we explicitly call out rollback/fallback plan in the "Risks & Mitigation" section.

Hi Sarah / Miguel —

Thanks for filling in stakeholders in the doc. We made the internal updates Marissa suggested and pushed an "acceptance criteria" table to the GDoc. TL;DR below and links/attachments at the bottom.

Summary (what we’ll do in the 6-week pilot)
- Week 0: Kickoff & infra checklist (secure connectivity, sample dataset prep). Owner: BrightPath infra (Miguel).
- Weeks 1–2: Integration + smoke tests (end-to-end tokenization, KV caching validation). Owner: BrightPath + Redwood infra.
- Weeks 3–4: Load validation & cost profiling (target 1k QPS perf run; measure tokens/sec and unit cost). Owner: Redwood SRE.
- Week 5: Acceptance run (production-like trace & quality check vs baseline prompts). Acceptance criteria: latency 95th ≤ 250ms; no more than 5% regression in LLM accuracy on benchmark set.
- Week 6: Decision gate (report + exec 30-min review).

Action items for BrightPath
- Confirm workshop attendees in the GDoc by Oct 24 EOD.
- Provide a sample dataset (anonymized) and a small set of baseline prompts by Oct 27.

Proposed kickoff: Oct 29, 2025 — 45 min (tech + product + success). Confirm availability?

Links & attachments
- Updated MAP GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEXAMPLEmap-draft (we added acceptance table).
- MAP Slides (starter): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1SlideEXAMPLE-map-slides
- Attached: MAP_OnePager_v1.pdf, Draft_MAP_Slides_v1.pptx
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4781

Looking forward —
